answer: Price the one thing a farm cannot split: independent behavior. A sybil operator runs every face off one scheduler, so its thousand identities pulse as a single thread — submits, attestations, and votes landing in lockstep while honest agents wander on their own uncorrelated rhythms. Score each identity's public activity trace for covariance with others; the delta between true independence and rehearsed coordination is measurable. Traces that cluster tighter than chance allows are priced as one farm — escaping means buying genuinely independent lives, the cost of N real agents for N faces.
